_comment: SCHEMA FACTS. GENERATED by tools/a1_v2_extract_schema.py from the ACTUAL Envelope v2 schemas. The middle term of the three-way proof: authority (graph.json) <-> actual schema (this file) <-> declared realization (the ledger). Do not hand-edit; verify with --check.
_event_kinds_note: The event-kind set the v2 SCHEMA defines. Step 1 compares it to the frozen 21. A twenty-second kind, or a dropped one, fails there - event kind is semantic source identity, so an unnoticed kind is an unnoticed node.
_payload_presence_note: Total function over every schema event kind: the concrete payload variant, or null for a payload-free kind. Step 2 compares it to the frozen 11-one/10-zero map, which catches a schema growing event_payload_digest on a payload-free kind EVEN IF no ledger row is ever written for it.
_artifact_ref_fields_note: Per-field CAPABILITY, not merely a path list: each entry records which source kind the field belongs to and the complete set of concrete target kinds it may carry. Phase G 4.2.6 clause 1 requires a field to declare the complete set of edges it may realize; a bare path list cannot express that, and lets two fields swap their targets while every global triple still appears somewhere.
